kinds.label: Movies
kinds.tooltip: Feature films, one file or folder per film.
kinds.explainer: Feature films, one file or folder per film.
kinds.library_does: Looks up posters, cast and details.

kinds.label: TV Shows
kinds.tooltip: Series with seasons and episodes, one folder per show.
kinds.explainer: Shows with seasons and episodes, one folder per show.
kinds.library_does: Looks up posters, episodes and details.

kinds.label: YouTube
kinds.tooltip: Videos saved from YouTube, found by the video ID in the file name.
kinds.explainer: Videos saved from YouTube, grouped by channel.
kinds.library_does: Matches each video by its YouTube ID.

kinds.label: Videos
kinds.tooltip: Courses, talks and downloads. Nothing is looked up.
kinds.explainer: Anything watchable that is not a film or show.
kinds.library_does: Keeps your files as they are; nothing is looked up.

kinds.label: Adult content
kinds.tooltip: Adult videos and pictures. Nothing is looked up by default.
kinds.explainer: Adult videos and pictures, kept in the Vault.
kinds.library_does: Keeps your files as they are; nothing is looked up.

kinds.label: Music
kinds.tooltip: Albums and songs, tagged or in artist and album folders.
kinds.explainer: Albums and songs, tagged or in artist and album folders.
kinds.library_does: Looks up covers, artists and track details.

kinds.label: Audiobooks
kinds.tooltip: Spoken books, one file or folder per book.
kinds.explainer: Spoken books, one file or folder per book.
kinds.library_does: Looks up covers, narrators and details.

kinds.label: Other audio
kinds.tooltip: Random audio files, recordings and lectures, shown by folder and the tags inside the files.
kinds.explainer: Audio that is not music or a book.
kinds.library_does: Shows files by folder and the tags inside them.

kinds.label: Books
kinds.library_does: Looks up covers, authors and series.

kinds.label: Comics
kinds.tooltip: CBZ and CBR comics and manga.
kinds.explainer: CBZ and CBR comics and manga.
kinds.library_does: Looks up covers, series and issue details.

kinds.label: Other reading
kinds.tooltip: Loose books and reading material with no match, shown by folder and the details inside the files.
kinds.explainer: Reading material that is not a book or comic.
kinds.library_does: Shows files by folder and the details inside them.

kinds.label: Photos
kinds.tooltip: Pictures from phones and cameras. View sorts them by date and place.
kinds.explainer: Pictures and videos from phones and cameras, together.
kinds.library_does: Sorts each file by what it is, then by date and place.

kinds.label: Personal videos
kinds.tooltip: Videos from phones and cameras, kept with the day they were taken.
kinds.library_does: Keeps them with the day they were taken.

kinds.label: Documents
kinds.tooltip: PDFs, Office files and photos of paper. Text inside them can be searched.
kinds.explainer: PDFs, Office files and photos of paper.
